components.name: generic-extraction
components.scope: Direct HTTP media and uncompressed UTF-8/ASCII HTML5 pages with one audio/video element, typed progressive HTTP sources and explicit zero-based source-ID selection; no embedded players, automatic ranking, multiple elements or manifests

components.name: extractor-contract
components.scope: Small typed video info and progressive VideoFormat subset, explicit selection, ordered extractor registry, shared direct response inspection; no typed playlist results

components.name: http-downloader
components.scope: Streaming whole-file transfers, page referrers for HTML5 media, no-clobber publication; no resume or retries

components.name: orchestration-and-output
components.scope: Multiple URLs, simulate, JSON, basic output templates, literal HTML5 source-ID selection; no general option parity
